title: 第13章 大长老突破第14章 郝忠离
slug: 打造万古家族开局奖励极道帝兵
lines: 一路快马加鞭，到第二天下午，李行歌一行人才赶回青枫谷。
在李行歌不在的这几天里，家族并没有发生什么大事。
除了外出巡查家族领地的四长老，其余几位长老都被李行歌召集到了议事堂。
众人依次落座。
看着几位长老欲言又止的样子，李行歌哈哈一笑，从怀中拿出了装着气血丹的檀木盒子。
“诸位长老，这，便是气血丹。”
众人的呼吸声陡然加重。
李行歌打开了木盒。
在木盒打开的那一刹那，一股浓郁至极的丹香便从盒子中飘了出来。
顷刻间，丹香便充斥着整个议事堂。
众人贪婪的嗅着这丹香。
二长老一脸惊叹道：“不愧是二品宝丹，光是闻上一闻，便抵我三天苦修。”
其余人也啧啧称奇。
“丹药好是好，就是太贵了，仅此一枚，就掏空了我李家的家底。”
三长老神情有些肉疼的道。
三长老李玄庸执掌家族财政，是李家出了名的守财奴，小气鬼。
“那又如何，若能让家族再多出一位气血境修士，花再多，那都是值得的。”
五长老李玄奇笑着道。
而大长老见多识广，气血丹他有幸见过一次，但其丹香程度远不及李行歌手中这枚。
“家主，这莫非是上品气血丹？”
大长老蹙眉道。
李行歌眉头一挑，显得有些诧异。
“大长老倒是好眼力，不错，这一枚正是上品气血丹，能增加突破时四成的成功率！”
众人闻言，纷纷倒吸了一口凉气。
“上品气血丹，那我们带去的钱，怕是不够吧......”
三长老语气干巴巴的道。
“哈哈，这枚气血丹，没有花钱。”
看着三长老这个样子，坐在一旁的李延昭终于是忍不住了，大笑道。
“没有花钱？”
众人一头雾水。
“那这气血丹是哪来的？”
看到众人疑惑的目光，李延昭也不卖关子了，便将一路上发生的事都娓娓道来。
众人听完，无不拍掌叫好。
“这莽山苏氏下此血本，购置气血丹，看来是真的急了。”
大长老捋着胡须道。
“只是没想到，最终是赔了夫人又折兵，人财两空。”
三长老一脸幸灾乐祸。
“好在家主突破气血境，力挽狂澜，若不然，对上莽山苏氏，我李家十死无生。”
五长老一脸唏嘘的道。
content_en:
After working hard all the way, it was not until the afternoon of the next day that Li Xingge and his party rushed back to Qingmaple Valley.
During Li Xingge's absence, nothing major happened in the family.
Except for the four elders who went out to inspect the family territory, the other elders were summoned to the meeting hall by Li Xingge.
Everyone took their seats one by one.
Seeing the elders hesitating to speak, Li Xingge laughed and took out the sandalwood box containing the Qi and Blood Pills from his arms.
"Elders, this is the Qi and Blood Pill."
Everyone's breathing suddenly became heavier.
Li Xingge opened the wooden box.
The moment the wooden box was opened, a strong fragrance of elixir wafted out from the box.
In an instant, the fragrance of elixir filled the entire meeting hall.
Everyone greedily sniffed the fragrance of the elixir.
The second elder exclaimed with a look of amazement: "It is indeed a second-grade treasure pill. Just one sniff of it is worth my three days of hard work."
The others were also amazed.
"The elixir is good, but it's too expensive. Just one pill has emptied my Li family's fortune."
The third elder said with a somewhat painful expression.
The third elder, Li Xuanyong, is in charge of the family finances and is a notorious miser and stingy in the Li family.
"So what, if you can get one more Qi-blood monk in the family, no matter how much money you spend, it will be worth it."
Fifth Elder Li Xuanqi said with a smile.
The Great Elder was well-informed, and he was lucky enough to have seen the Qi-Blood Pill once, but its fragrance was far inferior to the one in Li Xing's song.
"Master, is this a high-grade Qi and Blood Pill?"
The great elder frowned.
Li Xingge raised his eyebrows, looking a little surprised.
"The Great Elder has good eyesight. Yes, this one is a top-grade Qi and Blood Pill. It can increase the success rate of breakthrough by 40%!"
When everyone heard this, they took a deep breath.
"High-grade Qi and Blood Pill, then the money we brought may not be enough..."
The third elder said in a dry tone.
"Haha, this Qi and Blood Pill cost nothing."
Seeing the third elder like this, Li Yanzhao, who was sitting aside, finally couldn't help it anymore and laughed.
"No money?"
Everyone was confused.
"Then where does this Qi and Blood Pill come from?"
Seeing everyone's confused looks, Li Yanzhao stopped talking and told everything that happened along the way.
After hearing this, everyone clapped their hands and applauded.
"The Mangshan Su family has spent so much money to purchase Qi and Blood Pills. It seems that they are really in a hurry."
The great elder stroked his beard and said.
"I just didn't expect that in the end, I would lose my wife and lose my troops, and I would lose both my men and my money."
The third elder looked gloating.
"Fortunately, the head of the family has broken through the Qi and Blood realm and turned the tide. Otherwise, if we face the Mangshan Su family, our Li family will be dead."
The fifth elder said with a sigh on his face.
title_en: Chapter 13 The Great Elder’s Breakthrough Chapter 14 Hao Zhongli
